name: og-adv-generic-nonequilibrium
title: Adversarial: generic nonequilibrium control
question: Does a generic nonequilibrium chemical system with no vent-specific features (no sustained H2, no Fe/Ni/S catalytic interface, no pore concentration) pass the vent-specific gates? It SHOULD NOT.
hypothesis: The og-01/og-02/og-03 gates REJECT this control; if they pass it, the gates measure generic nonequilibrium chemistry, not the vent mechanism.
objective: Run the og-01..03 behavior tests on a vent-feature-ablated control; the campaign's gates must reject it, and the vent must pass the same tests.
claim: The og-01/02/03 gates are vent-specific and falsifiable. A generic nonequilibrium control — the SAME real composites with no sustained H2, no Fe/Ni/S catalytic interface and no pore concentration — is rejected by every discriminating gate (carbon flux, formate yield, protometabolic throughput, thermophoretic Péclet, enrichment), while the vent passes all five. So a PASS elsewhere in the campaign certifies the vent MECHANISM, not merely "some nonequilibrium chemistry".
result: All five discriminating gates reject the generic control (tightest margin 1.8 decades below threshold) and the vent passes all five — the campaign's gates are falsifiable and vent-specific.

findings.statement: Every vent-specific gate rejects the generic control. Running the real og-01/02/03 composites with no sustained H2, no Fe/Ni/S catalyst and no pore concentration, all five discriminating gates fall below threshold — net C-flux 4e-13 vs 1e-6 mol/s; formate ~0 vs 50 mM; protometabolic throughput 3e-13 vs 1e-6 mol/s; accumulation Péclet 0.26 vs 18; enrichment 1.3 vs 1e6 fold — the tightest by 1.8 decades. The vent passes all five.

evidence.observed: min rejection margin 1.84 decades (tightest gate: og-03 accumulation Péclet, generic 0.26 < 18); all 5 gates reject generic, vent passes all 5

findings.explanation: The vent features are PARAMETERS on the same real composites, so the control is a parameterization of the vent models, not a hand-tuned mock. No dissolved H2 → no CO2 reduction; no Fe/Ni/S interface → no abiotic carbon fixation; an open pore → no thermophoretic concentration.

findings.statement: The gates are vent-specific detectors, not generic nonequilibrium detectors — the vent passes where the control fails on each of the five gates. A PASS therefore certifies the vent mechanism (sustained H2 + Fe/Ni/S catalysis + pore concentration), falsifying the "the gates just measure any driven chemistry" objection.

evidence.observed: vent passes 5/5 gates; generic control fails 5/5 — pass-where-control-fails on every gate

findings.explanation: Falsification exposure for the whole investigation — the headline claims would be hollow if a feature-ablated control cleared the same bars. It does not.

findings.statement: Building the control exposed a latent control-integrity bug — catalyst_active=0 was silently swallowed by process-bigraph's is_empty(Float, 0.0) and refilled with the default, so the no-catalyst control (here AND in og-01's cross-run gate) secretly ran WITH full catalyst. Clamping to 1e-6 honors the control; og-01's gates still pass (9/9 + both cross-run) with the now-truthful control.

evidence.observed: no-catalyst formate dropped from ~0.014 mM (catalyst silently on) to ~2e-8 mM (honored); og-01 still PASS

findings.explanation: Same gotcha as og-04's mix_fraction=0; a control parameter set to exactly 0.0 must be clamped to a negligible floor so the ablation is real.

report.title: Adversarial control — generic nonequilibrium
report.verdict: PASS — the gates reject the generic control (all 5) and the vent passes all 5; the campaign is falsifiable and vent-specific
report.main_insight: A generic nonequilibrium control built by removing the vent features from the real composites is rejected by every discriminating gate, while the vent passes them all — so the campaign's gates measure the vent mechanism, not generic driven chemistry.
report.conclusion: The adversarial control closes the falsifiability loop for the investigation. Running the SAME og-01/02/03 composites with no sustained H2, no Fe/Ni/S catalytic interface and no pore concentration, all five discriminating gates reject it (tightest margin 1.8 decades) where the vent passes all five. A PASS anywhere in the campaign therefore certifies the vent mechanism rather than generic nonequilibrium chemistry.
report.caveat: One control family (feature ablation on the three composites). Other non-vent scenarios (e.g. atmospheric or impact-driven chemistries) are not modeled; this control falsifies the "any driven chemistry passes" objection, not every alternative.

biological_validation.basis: The generic non-vent control is rejected by every discriminating gate, while the vent passes all five — the gates are vent-specific.

explanatory_gain.basis: Demonstrates falsification exposure for the whole investigation — the gates could have passed a feature-ablated control and did not.

limitations: One control family (feature ablation on the og-01/02/03 composites); alternative non-vent chemistries (atmospheric, impact, surface) are out of scope.
The gates are lower-bound thresholds; the control is rejected by margin, not by a two-sided equivalence test.

resolved_uncertainties: The og-01/02/03 gates are vent-specific and falsifiable — a feature-ablated generic control is rejected by all five while the vent passes all five.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether broader non-vent scenario families (atmospheric/impact/surface chemistries) are also rejected.

followup_study_proposals.rationale: Add a second adversarial family (e.g. an atmospheric-spark or impact-plume control) and confirm the gates reject it too.
